letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my endless sunshine,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you.  It’s been a little over a year since 23 Feb 2025, and each day I fall deeper for my cutie—your laughter, your kindness, your love.  I cherish our evenings on the balcony, the way you sip tea, and the quiet moments when our hearts speak louder than words.  Thank you for making every place feel like home.
poem:
Across the dunes or by the river’s song,  
Your smile turns ordinary days strong.  
Together we dance, my love, hand in hand,  
Forever yours, your ever‑faithful man.
